summary: 80-ft Aermotor LS-40 WV Division of Forestry tower completed 1950 in Sleepy Creek WMA; sold for scrap and removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Sold for scrap and removed many years ago, per the National Historic Lookout Register; removal date not given

events.note: October 1948 newspaper notice, quoted on Forest Lookouts, announced a fire tower for Sleepy Creek Mountain
Completed 1950 per the Register; a February 1950 notice describes the material waiting in a barn and crews getting ready to erect it
West Virginia forest fire towers were closed statewide in 1990; the source does not name this tower
Registered December 25, 2022 as US 1702, WV 28; nominated by Brian M. Powell
Registered July 19, 2026 as US 2129, WV 88; nominated by Jason Johns

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register give Morgan County, while Forest Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list Berkeley. Wikipedia says the Sleepy Creek WMA lies in both counties, so the story reports the conflict rather than picking one.

notes_for_editor: Gone tower with thin sourcing: the build, scrap and registration facts come from two registers, and the 1948 and 1950 notices are secondhand quotes on Forest Lookouts, not checked against the newspapers. Removal date and buyer are not in any source; the Division of Forestry was not contacted. No access level is given because the sources say nothing about whether the tower spot is open to visitors, and no source describes the site today. The brief's county (Morgan) is kept, with the conflict noted. Source pages carry a zero-width space before the agency name; the quote avoids it.
